categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Tianma Intelligent Control Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, sales, and service of unmanned intelligent mining control technologies and equipment. Its primary products include the SAM type comprehensive mechanized mining automation control system, SAC type hydraulic support electro-hydraulic control system, SAP type intelligent integrated fluid supply system, and related spare parts and professional operation and maintenance services. The company also provides intelligent manufacturing solutions for discrete manufacturing enterprises undergoing digital transformation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include unmanned intelligent mining control technology and high water-based hydraulic technology, supported by four major technology platforms: unmanned intelligent mining perception and control, industrial internet architecture with intrinsic safety control, high-pressure large-flow hydraulic control, and digital proportional control. It develops advanced electro-hydraulic control systems, intelligent integrated fluid supply systems, and automation control software, employing industrial Ethernet, AI, digital twin, and multi-sensor fusion. Production emphasizes intelligent manufacturing with automated, flexible assembly lines and digitalized quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company primarily serves large coal mining enterprises and equipment manufacturers in the coal mining industry, providing integrated intelligent mining control solutions to improve safety and efficiency. Key customers include state-owned coal groups such as Shandong Energy Group, China Coal Energy Group, National Energy Investment Group, and Shaanxi Coal and Chemical Industry Group. The company also targets emerging markets in intelligent manufacturing for discrete industries and is expanding its international presence in countries like Australia, Russia, Poland, Turkey, and Central Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant market presence in coal-rich regions including Shandong, Shaanxi, Shanxi, Inner Mongolia, and other central and western provinces. It has established sales and service institutions close to key coal mining areas. Internationally, it is expanding into Australia, Russia, Poland, Turkey, and Central Asia, with overseas sales reaching record levels and multiple international certifications obtained.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing Tianma operates primarily in the midstream segment of the coal mining supply chain, focusing on the development and manufacturing of intelligent control systems and hydraulic equipment for mining operations. It supplies core control systems and integrated fluid supply equipment to mining machinery manufacturers and directly to coal mining enterprises, also providing after-sales maintenance and digital operation services, thus covering both equipment production and downstream service aspects.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth, focusing on breakthroughs in unmanned intelligent mining control and high water-based hydraulic technologies. It invests heavily in R&D (8.32% of revenue), developing advanced control software, large-flow pumps, and intelligent manufacturing solutions. Strategic priorities include expanding intelligent mining automation, digital twin technology, AI integration, and developing new products like high-pressure plunger pumps and digital hydraulic valves. It also pursues international certification and market expansion, while fostering industry standards and collaborative innovation ecosystems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through sales of integrated unmanned intelligent mining control system solutions, including core control systems and fluid supply equipment. Additional revenue streams include spare parts sales, operation and maintenance services, and intelligent manufacturing solutions for discrete industries. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distributors, with contracts signed either directly with end coal mining enterprises or with mining machinery manufacturers who integrate the company’s systems.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the domestic unmanned intelligent mining control market, with a market share of approximately 38.5% in hydraulic support electro-hydraulic control systems and 38.8% in comprehensive mechanized mining automation control systems, ranking first in these segments. It is the second largest in the intelligent integrated fluid supply system market with a 16.8% share. The market is characterized by a duopoly in core systems and competitive multi-player dynamics in fluid supply, with the company recognized as a technology and market leader.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.86 billion, a 15.66% decrease year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 339.58 million, down 20.01%. Total assets reached RMB 5.83 billion, up 6.58%. Despite revenue decline due to market competition and coal price fluctuations, cash flow from operations increased by 38.02%. The company maintains a strong R&D investment ratio (~8.3%) and has a solid equity base with net assets of RMB 4.34 billion, reflecting a stable growth trajectory with strategic investments in innovation and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers integrated unmanned intelligent mining control solutions that significantly enhance coal mining safety and efficiency by enabling remote, automated, and continuous mining operations. Its products feature deep integration of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and software technologies, supported by proprietary core technologies and platforms. Unique offerings include high-pressure large-flow hydraulic systems, AI-enabled digital twin control, and flexible intelligent manufacturing solutions. The company’s solutions reduce labor intensity, improve operational reliability, and support green mining initiatives, differentiating it as a pioneer and leader in intelligent mining automation.
